title: CQL: dissect Prepared response
description:
It was not really dissected thus far.
Since its result metadata is identical to rows result, I've extracted it to its own function and used in both.

It also fixes a subtle bug in result parsing, while at it:
if Has_more_pages flag is set, then paging_state field should be the first to apper in the metadata, before the (optional) global_table_spec

Signed-off-by: Yaniv Kaul <mykaul@gmail.com>
